name: shine-docs
description: Skill set that turns documents and code changes into highly readable outputs: document-refactor (restructure an existing document to HTML/Markdown), write-document (write a new ticket, PR description, chat proposal, diff explanation, or general document from scratch), write-wiki (archive finished ticket work — experiments and decisions — to a personal Obsidian vault), and explain-diff-html (legacy, direct invocation only).
